source: DEVOPS-PLAN 11.3 and 11.4 (AIU-16 v2.2); thresholds are PROPOSED and calibrated at staging
destination: email to the Operations owner and the administrators (DOP-OI-3 default applied); no page-out is invented

alerts.name: App down
alerts.rule: GET /health/ready fails from 2 locations, 3 consecutive probes
alerts.missingDataSignal: No probe result for 15 minutes is reported by the uptime vendor as a paused monitor and emailed (uptime.json: monitorStaleMinutes)

alerts.name: Elevated 5xx
alerts.rule: 5xx ratio over 2% in windows[0] (10 minutes) of API-903
alerts.volumeCondition: At least 100 requests in the 10-minute window; below that the state is insufficient data (never green, never an alert)
alerts.recoveryCondition: windows[1] (15 minutes) with at least 100 requests and a 5xx ratio below 1% in one reading; the 15-minute auto-resolve of the issue is a Sentry issue-alert setting (sentry.json)
alerts.missingDataSignal: ALR-9: API-903 does not answer 200 with a valid body, and the monitor dead-man heartbeat (HEARTBEAT_URL_MONITOR)

alerts.name: Latency
alerts.rule: p95 over 500 ms in windows[1] (15 minutes) of API-903
alerts.volumeCondition: At least 200 requests in the 15-minute window and a non-null p95Ms; below that the state is insufficient data
alerts.recoveryCondition: Window with at least 200 requests and p95 not over 500 ms in one reading; the 30-minute auto-resolve is a Sentry issue-alert setting (sentry.json)
alerts.missingDataSignal: ALR-9 and the monitor dead-man heartbeat

alerts.name: Worker silent
alerts.rule: Dead-man heartbeat HEARTBEAT_URL_WORKER missing for 15 minutes (the worker sweep pings every 5 minutes)
alerts.volumeCondition: Not applicable: dead-man switch, one missed window
alerts.missingDataSignal: The absence of the heartbeat is the signal

alerts.name: Job backlog
alerts.rule: Oldest queued paid job older than 10 minutes while the worker is alive, or any job in submitting beyond the orphan threshold (admin_alerts raised by the worker)
alerts.volumeCondition: Any; page-worthy if it persists 1 hour
alerts.recoveryCondition: The queue drains and the alert resolves in admin_alerts
alerts.missingDataSignal: ALR-4: a silent worker raises no admin_alerts, so the worker heartbeat covers it

alerts.name: Backup stale
alerts.rule: Newest successful backup older than 26 hours (heartbeat HEARTBEAT_URL_BACKUP expected every 24 hours with a 2-hour grace)
alerts.volumeCondition: Not applicable: one missed expected ping
alerts.recoveryCondition: A fresh backup pings the heartbeat
alerts.missingDataSignal: The absence of the ping is the signal; a failed run sends no ping

alerts.name: Database pressure
alerts.rule: poolWait.p95WaitMs over 250 ms in API-903 (the 10-minute pool-wait object); connections or storage over 80% come from the host's own database alerts or the daily platform review
alerts.volumeCondition: At least 1 acquisition in the 10-minute object and a non-null p95WaitMs; otherwise insufficient data, no alert and no error
alerts.recoveryCondition: poolWait.p95WaitMs not over the threshold in one reading; host alerts below 70%
alerts.missingDataSignal: ALR-9 and the monitor dead-man heartbeat

alerts.name: Security or spend events
alerts.rule: Provider 401/429 burst, spend cap hit, KEK unseal failure, stuck deletion (admin_alerts raised by the worker)
alerts.volumeCondition: Per product rule (for example the 5th provider 401 or 429 in 10 minutes)
alerts.recoveryCondition: Per product rule: the admin alert is resolved
alerts.missingDataSignal: ALR-4: a silent worker raises no admin_alerts, so the worker heartbeat covers it

alerts.name: Telemetry missing
alerts.rule: API-903 does not answer 200 with a valid MetricsWindowResponse (404, 5xx, timeout, malformed body), or telemetryDropped10m is above 0; never telemetryDroppedTotal
alerts.volumeCondition: Not applicable: any failed read or any drop within the last 10 minutes
alerts.missingDataSignal: The monitor heartbeat (HEARTBEAT_URL_MONITOR) stopping for 15 minutes is the dead-man form of this alert

alerts.name: Certificate or domain expiry
alerts.rule: 21 days to expiry (the uptime vendor's SSL check)
alerts.volumeCondition: Not applicable: one check per day
alerts.recoveryCondition: The certificate or domain is renewed
alerts.missingDataSignal: No SSL result for 48 hours is reported by the uptime vendor as a paused monitor and emailed (uptime.json: monitorStaleMinutes)
